unknown_alias_rule.text: 未知字段在去除空白后，与题面原词或该题 unknown_aliases 中列出的等价写法一致即可

similarity.method: Python difflib.SequenceMatcher, character level, autojunk=False; whitespace/punctuation removed. Second view masks calendar phrases and Arabic numbers before normalizing.
similarity.normalization: 逐字符去除isspace及Unicode category P；不移除其它符号。
masking_regex_in_order: (?:\d{4}|[零〇一二三四五六七八九十]{4})年(?:\d{1,2}|[一二三四五六七八九十]+)月
similarity.caveat: 词面相似度不证明语义独立；0.80仅为原先登记的复核提示阈值。
